name: Lila Sciences
description: Lila Sciences is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Lila Sciences is a privately held artificial intelligence company focused on scientific research. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $115 million extension of its Series A round announced on October 14, 2025, valued the company at $1.3 billion.

Based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Lila Sciences develops AI models and automated laboratories that generate scientific hypotheses and run the experiments that test them. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Lila Sciences
Shares reported by ARK Venture Fund (July 31, 2026)
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round, by Bloomberg for the Series A and by Reuters for its extension. Lila Sciences has not announced a valuation.
round_notes: Lila Sciences has said the extension brought its total funding to $550 million. In June 2026, Bloomberg reported that the company was in talks to raise $2 billion at a valuation of $8.5 billion before the new investment. Lila Sciences has not announced a further round.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Braidwell and Collective Global co-led the Series A, and Nvidia's venture arm, NVentures, joined in the October 2025 extension. Flagship Pioneering, ARK Venture Fund, General Catalyst and March Capital invested in the $200 million seed round. Other investors include Altitude Life Science Ventures, the State of Michigan Retirement System and a subsidiary of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority.
spv_sentence: Since 2025, four special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Lila Sciences have filed with the SEC, two of them in 2026.
funds: One SEC-registered fund reports a position in Lila Sciences. As of July 31, 2026, ARK Venture Fund held 1,571,312 shares, which it valued at $17.8 million, or $11.31 per share.
sources: Sources: Lila Sciences announcements dated September 15, 2025 and October 2025; reports by SiliconANGLE (March 2025), Bloomberg (September 2025 and June 2026), MobiHealthNews (September 2025) and Reuters (October 2025); ARK Venture Fund's Form N-PORT for July 31, 2026; and SEC Form D filings.
